prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on your goals, budget, platform, and level of creative control. That said, these are the market leaders (2024) and what they’re best at:

Top picks
- Synthesia — Best for AI presenters/realistic avatars and multilingual spoken ads. Great for product explainers or personalized video messages. Higher cost but very polished.
- Canva — Best low-cost/easiest all‑rounder for social ads. Lots of templates, simple AI tools, stock video, and vertical formats. Fast for small businesses.
- InVideo — Strong template library and flexible editor for social ads. Good balance of price, speed, and control.
- Pictory — Best for repurposing long-form content (blogs, webinars, podcasts) into multiple short ads with captions and summaries.
- Pencil — Best for performance-driven ad generation; creates many ad variants and predicts likely winners (used by marketers focused on ROAS).
- Runway (and similar generative editors) — Best for creative, novel visuals and advanced generative effects when you want ads that stand out visually.
- Smartly.io / VidMob — Best enterprise-grade platforms for automated large-scale ad production, optimization, and platform integration.

Which to pick (quick guide)
- You need low cost, speed, and simple social ads: Canva or InVideo.
- You want realistic AI presenters or voiceovers in many languages: Synthesia or HeyGen.
- You’re repurposing webinars, podcasts, or blog posts into short ads: Pictory + Descript.
- You want many testable ad variations and performance prediction: Pencil (or Smartly.io for enterprise).
- You want unique, cutting‑edge visuals: Runway or advanced generative tools.

How to choose (criteria to compare)
- Output formats: vertical (9:16) for TikTok/Reels, square for Instagram, landscape for YouTube.
- Templates & speed: how fast you can produce a finished ad.
- Customization & brand control: fonts, colors, logo, scene timing.
- Voice options: real voice actors vs AI voices vs avatars.
- Stock assets & music library and licensing for ads.
- Integration with ad platforms and workflow (upload, A/B testing, analytics).
- Price and commercial usage rights.
- Trial availability and how many videos/length included.

Recommended next step
Tell me: what platform(s) are you advertising on, what’s your budget, and do you need an on‑screen presenter or just text/graphics? I’ll recommend the best 1–2 tools and a quick workflow for creating your first ad.
